# abacus

Service abacus of the 6-r3 stand.
files.client.py:
import requests

BASE_URL = "https://refunds.test"


def load_day(day):
    response = requests.get(BASE_URL + "/refunds/count", params={"day": day}, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()["items"]
